elements.name: customerLocation
elements.label: Customer resource region
elements.toolTip: Region for the customer Routing Appliance, VPN gateways and VMs. The resource-scope Region field controls RG metadata only. Provider placement stays provider-controlled. Availability, quota and policy are checked by Azure.

elements.name: firewallType
elements.label: Provider firewall
elements.defaultValue: Check Point CloudGuard scale set, 2 BYOL gateways (lab preview)
elements.toolTip: The Check Point scale set is the default: two BYOL gateways behind internal and public load balancers. Check Point options are lab previews that the provider must enable; choose Ubuntu simulator for the lightweight lab path.

allowedValues.label: Check Point CloudGuard scale set, 2 BYOL gateways (lab preview)

elements.name: adminAllowedSources
elements.label: Public admin IPv4 hosts or CIDRs (comma separated)
elements.toolTip: Optional: up to 16 public unicast IPv4 sources for management HTTPS/SSH/SmartConsole, gateway HTTPS/SSH, and customer test VM SSH. Bare IPs become /32. No private, reserved, IPv6 or /0 ranges. Provider may preset office/home; edit or clear them. Validated before customer network deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter at most 16 comma-separated public IPv4 hosts/CIDRs, or leave empty.

options.text: Check Point lab preview: the provider deploys real CloudGuard gateways (one BYOL gateway, or a two-instance BYOL scale set with load balancers) and a management server, which takes about 90 minutes. The deployment stops before any change if the selected option is not available from the provider.

elements.name: runId
elements.label: Approved lab run ID
elements.toolTip: Provider preparation presets this enrollment ID. Select or create a dedicated RG in the enrolled customer subscription. A stable per-RG deployment identifier is derived automatically.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the approved 3-32 character run ID.

elements.name: apiClientId
elements.label: Customer API client ID
elements.toolTip: Customer-specific API-only identity supplied by Check Point. It has no Azure RBAC.

elements.name: apiClientSecret
elements.toolTip: API-only credential supplied through approved onboarding. Never enter an Azure administrator password.

elements.name: approveDeploymentScriptBackingException
elements.label: I approve this billable lab deployment, temporary execution/storage, and unrestricted lab NSG traffic when no admin list is set

constraints.validationMessage: Approve the billable lab deployment and temporary execution/backing storage. Empty admin lists retain legacy unrestricted lab NSGs.

elements.name: manualSshKey
elements.label: Paste an existing OpenSSH public key instead (including ECDSA)

toolTip.sshPublicKey: Choose or generate an SSH key. An admin list restricts public test VM SSH; an empty list retains legacy lab NSGs and private test VMs.

elements.name: sshPublicKey
elements.label: Customer workload SSH public key
elements.toolTip: Public key only. Never paste a private key. An admin list restricts public test VM SSH; an empty list retains legacy lab NSGs and private test VMs.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an OpenSSH public key, not a private key.

elements.name: routingApplianceBandwidthGbps
elements.label: Routing Appliance bandwidth
elements.toolTip: Only the verified 10-Gbps size is available initially. No claim is made about an unverified Routing Appliance price or cheaper size.

elements.name: customerIngressVpnGatewaySku
elements.label: Customer ingress VPN gateway SKU
elements.toolTip: Customer resources only. Provider gateway sizing is unchanged. Larger customer gateways do not guarantee higher end-to-end throughput.

elements.name: customerDeliveryVpnGatewaySku
elements.label: Customer delivery VPN gateway SKU
elements.toolTip: Delivery requires BGP, so Basic is not offered. Review Azure costs before choosing a larger size.
